screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows a galvanic cell: two beakers, each with a metal electrode in a solution of its ion, joined by a salt bridge. A voltmeter is connected across the electrodes, and a wire with a light bulb and a switch joins them.
screenSummary.controlArea: The control area has menus for the left and right half-cells, checkboxes for the salt bridge and the light bulb, checkboxes to show the reactions and the ions, a New Cell button, time controls, and Reset All.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Choose two half-cells, then connect the light bulb and play to watch the cell run down.

galvanicCell.currentDetailsPattern: Left: {{left}}. Right: {{right}}. The voltmeter reads {{voltage}} volts. {{state}}
galvanicCell.anodeIsPattern: The {{anode}} electrode is the anode and the {{cathode}} electrode is the cathode.
galvanicCell.noReaction: Both electrodes are at the same potential.

responses.bulbConnectedPattern: Bulb connected. Electrons flow from the {{anode}} anode to the {{cathode}} cathode, and the bulb lights.
responses.bulbConnectedNoCurrent: Bulb connected, but no current flows.
responses.saltBridgeRemoved: Salt bridge removed. The circuit is open and the voltmeter reads zero.
responses.saltBridgeInsertedPattern: Salt bridge in place. The voltmeter reads {{value}} volts.
responses.currentDied: The current has died away: the cathode's ion is used up.

screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows a small galvanic cell, a chart of cell potential against the logarithm of the reaction quotient, and the Nernst equation worked out for the present concentrations.
screenSummary.controlArea: The control area has menus for the two half-cells, sliders for each ion's concentration and the temperature, buttons to swap the half-cells and build a concentration cell, a checkbox to connect the light bulb, time controls, and Reset All.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Change a concentration and watch the potential move along the Nernst line.

nernst.currentDetailsPattern: Q is {{q}} and log Q is {{logQ}}. E standard is {{standard}} volts and E is {{value}} volts. {{verdict}}

responses.swapped: Half-cells swapped. The reaction as written is reversed.
responses.concentrationCell: Copper concentration cell: 0.010 molar on the left, 1.0 molar on the right.
responses.equilibrium: The cell has reached equilibrium: E is zero and Q equals K.

screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows an electrolytic cell: a beaker of electrolyte with two electrodes wired to a DC power supply, and gas-collection tubes when gases form.
screenSummary.controlArea: The control area has a menu of electrolytic cells, a power switch, a voltage slider, a New Run button, a checkbox to show the Faraday's law calculation, time controls, and Reset All.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Turn the power on above the minimum voltage and compare the amount of product with the charge passed.

responses.anodeDissolved: The anode has dissolved. The run has stopped.
